weight_policy.packing: row-major output row then input lane; even flat index in low nibble and odd flat index in high nibble

row_scale.format: existing normalized unsigned-Q1.15 Scale32 significand plus signed exponent record
row_scale.all_zero_weight_row_rule: use the frozen all-zero Scale32 record and payload index of the codepoint nearest zero

joint_construction_algorithm.initial_row_scale: freshly recompute ceil(absmax/7) normalized Scale32 for every nonzero output row
joint_construction_algorithm.initial_codebook: freshly recompute the V3 exact-histogram 32-iteration Lloyd-Max tensor codebook; do not import a V3 candidate manifest or mutable state
joint_construction_algorithm.assignment_step: Assign every BF16 weight to the nearest reconstructed level row_scale times codepoint_q4_4 divided by 16; exact-distance ties select the lower index.
joint_construction_algorithm.row_scale_step: With indices and codepoints fixed, form the exact dyadic least-squares ideal 16*sum(weight*codepoint)/sum(codepoint^2). Constrain it to the no-overflow lower bound absmax*16/127 and the legal Scale32 range. Evaluate the legal Scale32 records bracketing that ideal, their immediate normalized-significand neighbors, and the prior record using source-space row SSE; choose minimum SSE, then smaller positive scale, then smaller packed record on ties.
joint_construction_algorithm.codebook_step: With indices and row scales fixed, accumulate exact per-cluster source-space quadratic costs for every signed-Q4.4 value -128 through +127. Use dynamic programming to choose the globally minimum-cost strictly increasing 16-value codebook. Empty clusters retain their prior codepoint as a hard constraint; total-cost ties choose the lexicographically smaller codebook.
joint_construction_algorithm.iteration_acceptance: Reassign after each row-scale and codebook update. Source-space tensor SSE may not increase from the preceding outer iteration; a violation fails closed. Execute all eight iterations even after a fixed point.

activation_policy.payload: signed A8 symmetric range -127 through +127 with -128 reserved
activation_policy.base_record_source: the same frozen authenticated activation Scale32 significands used by V3
activation_policy.selection_rule: For each live finite group, preserve the base activation Scale32 significand and choose the minimum integer exponent delta in [-24,+24] whose effective exponent remains in [-24,+4] and covers every lane without saturation.
activation_policy.failure_rule: If no legal delta covers a finite group, fail closed; never clip, saturate, or mutate the base activation significand.

accelerator_facing_format.weight_payload_transport: existing 128-bit external-memory read channel; packed 4-bit indices retain the existing byte count
accelerator_facing_format.row_scale_transport: existing one 32-bit Scale32 record per output row; only record values change
accelerator_facing_format.codebook_transport: one aligned 128-bit read beat per Linear tensor before its weight stream
accelerator_facing_format.compute_primitive: signed A8 activation multiplied by signed Q4.4 codepoint, accumulated as an integer product, then combined with the row Scale32 and fixed fractional shift four
